description: Return recent app console output, including shim-forwarded output when Metro is externally owned, optionally filtered by log level.

lines.description: Number of recent lines to return (default: 50)

projectDir.description: React Native/Expo project directory. Omit when the coding client's workspace identifies one app; supply it to disambiguate projects.

waitMs.description: Wait up to this many milliseconds for matching output when the current buffer is empty (default: 0). Resolves immediately on arrival.

name: rn_get_console
